title: LearnIT v6 single publisher decommission and promotion preflight (non-deployable draft)
purpose: Disable eight historical GitHub Pages publication paths while retaining their non-publishing verifications; introduce one explicitly non-executable v6 root promotion skeleton for review only.
invariants: Eight historical workflows retain verification jobs where feasible; none can call actions/deploy-pages, actions/upload-pages-artifact or request pages:write/id-token:write.
The sole new deploy job is doubly blocked by a permanently false job-level guard and an unconditional failing step.
No current GitHub Pages artifact, root, authoring, historical replay, IndexedDB, fixture, product or Factory state is changed by this draft.
No merge, Pages deployment, Pages/environment settings change or publication authorization is implied by this candidate.
requiredEvidence: Exact ten-path diff and pinned baseline/old Git blob identities.
New single deploy-pages action only in the disabled candidate workflow.
Static YAML/scope checks, PR CI review, independent T2.
Before future release: full-site URL manifest, exact v6 root identity, compatible same-origin /recovery/v3, v2-v6 kit and accessibility matrix, live Pages protections, explicit new human GO.
unresolvedReleaseGates: G2 historical and external consumer inventory
G3 independent publisher exclusivity after merge

G6 independent T2 and new release GO
rollback: Before merge, close the draft PR and delete the candidate branch only under a separate authorization; main and Pages are unchanged.
adversarialTests: An old workflow_dispatch, main push, or pull_request must not reach deploy-pages or receive pages:write/id-token:write on any of the eight retired workflows.
The proposed new deployment job must remain unreachable despite workflow_dispatch inputs; its first step must fail unconditionally even if the job-level guard is edited.
Reject any branch diff outside the ten exact allowed paths or any blob drift against the frozen base.
Reject v6 preflight if source Git blob inputs are unavailable or repeated builds differ from each other or the expected SHA-256.
Reject release if any historical URL or authoring asset is missing, any old IndexedDB v3 cannot be reopened, or the compatible same-origin recovery route is absent.
Reject main merge or Pages publication without separate explicit human authority and independent T2 acceptance.
nonGoals: Publishing LearnIT v6, changing GitHub Pages settings, starting a workflow release, merging the PR, or releasing to end users.
